test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

One of my __best friends are here__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence "**One of my best friends**" requires that the verb agrees with "**one**", which is singular.
 
• Therefore, the correct verb form should be "**is**" instead of "**are**".
 
• Option 4 correctly changes "**friends are**" to "**friends is**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *One of my best friends is here.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **One of my better friends is here** – Incorrect option, because "better" doesn’t fit the context.
 
• **One of my best friend is here** – Incorrect option, singular "friend" doesn’t fit since we're referring to one among many friends.
 
• **One of my better friends are here** – Incorrect option, "better" doesn’t fit the context.
